'''Kalarcha''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Athallia]]. [[Fin Mak'lath]] was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to Kalarcha but moved to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] after his [[Fin Mak'lath's wife|wife]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] there in [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] riots.
